  - `buildEmbeddedSystemPrompt(...)`
  - `createSystemPromptOverride(...)`
  - `applySystemPromptOverrideToSession(...)`
  - Called during session startup around lines `53500–53665`

The important handoff is:

```js
const appendPrompt = buildEmbeddedSystemPrompt(...)
let systemPromptText = createSystemPromptOverride(appendPrompt)()
...
applySystemPromptOverrideToSession(session, systemPromptText)
```

There’s also a “current-ish” parameter/report side nearby:

- `src/agents/system-prompt-params.ts` around line `52145`
- `src/agents/system-prompt-report.ts` around line `52183`

`src/agents/system-prompt.ts`

and in this installed build it’s bundled into:

`dist/plugin-sdk/dispatch-4PYvcEOv.js`

content.text: There is an exported declaration for the prompt builder. I’ll call the packaged builder directly with the current workspace inputs and write the resulting full prompt string to disk.
I’ll generate the OpenClaw-built prompt string (not the model provider’s hidden wrapper) with the current workspace context and save it as UTF-8 for inspection.
I’ll use a local script to include the workspace files exactly as injected, then compute encoding stats and save both prompt + metadata.

arguments.command:
cat > /root/.openclaw/workspace/extract-system-prompt.mjs <<'NODE'
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import crypto from 'node:crypto';
import { buildAgentSystemPrompt } from '/usr/lib/node_modules/openclaw/dist/plugin-sdk/agents/system-prompt.js';

const workspaceDir = '/root/.openclaw/workspace';
const out = `${workspaceDir}/system-prompt-built.txt`;
const meta = `${workspaceDir}/system-prompt-built.meta.txt`;
const contextNames = ['AGENTS.md','SOUL.md','TOOLS.md','IDENTITY.md','USER.md','HEARTBEAT.md','BOOTSTRAP.md'];
const contextFiles = contextNames
  .filter(name => fs.existsSync(`${workspaceDir}/${name}`))
  .map(name => ({ path: `${workspaceDir}/${name}`, content: fs.readFileSync(`${workspaceDir}/${name}`, 'utf8') }));

const skillsPrompt = `## Skills (mandatory)
Before replying: scan <available_skills> <description> entries.
- If exactly one skill clearly applies: read its SKILL.md at <location> with \`read\`, then follow it.
- If multiple could apply: choose the most specific one, then read/follow it.
- If none clearly apply: do not read any SKILL.md.
Constraints: never read more than one skill up front; only read after selecting.
- When a skill drives external API writes, assume rate limits: prefer fewer larger writes, avoid tight one-item loops, serialize bursts when possible, and respect 429/Retry-After.
The following skills provide specialized instructions for specific tasks.
Use the read tool to load a skill's file when the task matches its description.
When a skill file references a relative path, resolve it against the skill directory (parent of SKILL.md / dirname of the path) and use that absolute path in tool commands.

<available_skills>
  <skill>
    <name>healthcheck</name>
    <description>Host security hardening and risk-tolerance configuration for OpenClaw deployments. Use when a user asks for security audits, firewall/SSH/update hardening, risk posture, exposure review, OpenClaw cron scheduling for periodic checks, or version status checks on a machine running OpenClaw (laptop, workstation, Pi, VPS).</description>
    <location>/usr/lib/node_modules/openclaw/skills/healthcheck/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>skill-creator</name>
    <description>Create, edit, improve, or audit AgentSkills. Use when creating a new skill from scratch or when asked to improve, review, audit, tidy up, or clean up an existing skill or SKILL.md file. Also use when editing or restructuring a skill directory (moving files to references/ or scripts/, removing stale content, validating against the AgentSkills spec). Triggers on phrases like "create a skill", "author a skill", "tidy up a skill", "improve this skill", "review the skill", "clean up the skill", "audit the skill".</description>
    <location>/usr/lib/node_modules/openclaw/skills/skill-creator/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>weather</name>
    <description>Get current weather and forecasts via wttr.in or Open-Meteo. Use when: user asks about weather, temperature, or forecasts for any location. NOT for: historical weather data, severe weather alerts, or detailed meteorological analysis. No API key needed.</description>
    <location>/usr/lib/node_modules/openclaw/skills/weather/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
</available_skills>`;

const prompt = buildAgentSystemPrompt({
  workspaceDir,
  defaultThinkLevel: undefined,
  reasoningLevel: 'off',
  extraSystemPrompt: undefined,
  ownerNumbers: [],
  ownerDisplay: 'raw',
  reasoningTagHint: false,
  toolNames: ['read','write','edit','exec','process','web_search','web_fetch','browser','canvas','nodes','cron','message','gateway','agents_list','sessions_list','sessions_history','sessions_send','sessions_spawn','subagents','session_status','memory_get','memory_search','tts'],
  toolSummaries: {
    memory_get: 'Safe snippet read from MEMORY.md or memory/*.md with optional from/lines; use after memory_search to pull only the needed lines and keep context small.',
    memory_search: 'Mandatory recall step: semantically search MEMORY.md + memory/*.md (and optional session transcripts) before answering questions about prior work, decisions, dates, people, preferences, or todos; returns top snippets with path + lines. If response has disabled=true, memory retrieval is unavailable and should be surfaced to the user.',
    tts: 'Convert text to speech. Audio is delivered automatically from the tool result — reply with NO_REPLY after a successful call to avoid duplicate messages.'
  },
  modelAliasLines: [],
  userTimezone: 'UTC',
  userTime: undefined,
  userTimeFormat: '24h',
  contextFiles,
  skillsPrompt,
  heartbeatPrompt: 'Read HEARTBEAT.md if it exists (workspace context). Follow it strictly. Do not infer or repeat old tasks from prior chats. If nothing needs attention, reply HEARTBEAT_OK.',
  docsPath: '/usr/lib/node_modules/openclaw/docs',
  workspaceNotes: [],
  ttsHint: undefined,
  promptMode: 'full',
  acpEnabled: true,
  runtimeInfo: {
    agentId: 'main',
    host: os.hostname(),
    os: `${os.type()} ${os.release()}`,
    arch: os.arch(),
    node: process.version,
    model: 'idealab/gpt-5.5-0424-global',
    defaultModel: 'idealab/gpt-5.5-0424-global',
    channel: 'webchat',
    capabilities: [],
    repoRoot: workspaceDir
  },
  messageToolHints: [],
  memoryCitationsMode: undefined
});

fs.writeFileSync(out, prompt, 'utf8');
const buf = fs.readFileSync(out);
const codepoints = [...prompt];
const nonAscii = codepoints.filter(ch => ch.codePointAt(0) > 0x7f);
const suspicious = codepoints.filter(ch => /[\uFFFD\u0080-\u009F]/u.test(ch));
fs.writeFileSync(meta, [
  `generatedBy=${process.argv[1]}`,
  `builder=/usr/lib/node_modules/openclaw/dist/plugin-sdk/agents/system-prompt.js#buildAgentSystemPrompt`,
  `output=${out}`,
  `chars=${codepoints.length}`,
  `utf8Bytes=${buf.length}`,
  `nonAsciiCodepoints=${nonAscii.length}`,
  `replacementCharCount=${(prompt.match(/\uFFFD/g)||[]).length}`,
  `c1ControlCount=${codepoints.filter(ch => { const cp=ch.codePointAt(0); return cp>=0x80 && cp<=0x9F; }).length}`,
  `sha256=${crypto.createHash('sha256').update(buf).digest('hex')}`,
  `contextFiles=${contextFiles.map(f=>f.path).join(',')}`,
  ''
].join('\n'), 'utf8');
console.log(fs.readFileSync(meta,'utf8'));
NODE
node /root/.openclaw/workspace/extract-system-prompt.mjs
printf '\n--- first 50 lines ---\n'
sed -n '1,50p' /root/.openclaw/workspace/system-prompt-built.txt
printf '\n--- non-ascii sample ---\n'
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
s=Path('/root/.openclaw/workspace/system-prompt-built.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
seen=[]
for ch in s:
    if ord(ch)>127 and ch not in seen:
        seen.append(ch)
print(' '.join(f'U+{ord(ch):04X} {ch!r}' for ch in seen[:80]))

  .map(name => ({ path: `${workspaceDir}/${name}`, content: fs.readFileSync(`${workspaceDir}/${name}`, 'utf8') }));

const skillsPrompt = `## Skills (mandatory)
Before replying: scan <available_skills> <description> entries.
- If exactly one skill clearly applies: read its SKILL.md at <location> with \`read\`, then follow it.
- If multiple could apply: choose the most specific one, then read/follow it.
- If none clearly apply: do not read any SKILL.md.
Constraints: never read more than one skill up front; only read after selecting.
- When a skill drives external API writes, assume rate limits: prefer fewer larger writes, avoid tight one-item loops, serialize bursts when possible, and respect 429/Retry-After.
The following skills provide specialized instructions for specific tasks.
Use the read tool to load a skill's file when the task matches its description.
When a skill file references a relative path, resolve it against the skill directory (parent of SKILL.md / dirname of the path) and use that absolute path in tool commands.

<available_skills>
  <skill>
    <name>healthcheck</name>
    <description>Host security hardening and risk-tolerance configuration for OpenClaw deployments. Use when a user asks for security audits, firewall/SSH/update hardening, risk posture, exposure review, OpenClaw cron scheduling for periodic checks, or version status checks on a machine running OpenClaw (laptop, workstation, Pi, VPS).</description>
    <location>/usr/lib/node_modules/openclaw/skills/healthcheck/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>skill-creator</name>
    <description>Create, edit, improve, or audit AgentSkills. Use when creating a new skill from scratch or when asked to improve, review, audit, tidy up, or clean up an existing skill or SKILL.md file. Also use when editing or restructuring a skill directory (moving files to references/ or scripts/, removing stale content, validating against the AgentSkills spec). Triggers on phrases like "create a skill", "author a skill", "tidy up a skill", "improve this skill", "review the skill", "clean up the skill", "audit the skill".</description>
    <location>/usr/lib/node_modules/openclaw/skills/skill-creator/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>weather</name>
    <description>Get current weather and forecasts via wttr.in or Open-Meteo. Use when: user asks about weather, temperature, or forecasts for any location. NOT for: historical weather data, severe weather alerts, or detailed meteorological analysis. No API key needed.</description>
    <location>/usr/lib/node_modules/openclaw/skills/weather/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
</available_skills>`;

  workspaceDir,
  reasoningLevel: 'off',
  ownerNumbers: [],
  ownerDisplay: 'raw',

  toolNames: ['read','write','edit','exec','process','web_search','web_fetch','browser','canvas','nodes','cron','message','gateway','agents_list','sessions_list','sessions_history','sessions_send','sessions_spawn','subagents','session_status','memory_get','memory_search','tts'],
  toolSummaries: {
    memory_get: 'Safe snippet read from MEMORY.md or memory/*.md with optional from/lines; use after memory_search to pull only the needed lines and keep context small.',
    memory_search: 'Mandatory recall step: semantically search MEMORY.md + memory/*.md (and optional session transcripts) before answering questions about prior work, decisions, dates, people, preferences, or todos; returns top snippets with path + lines. If response has disabled=true, memory retrieval is unavailable and should be surfaced to the user.',
    tts: 'Convert text to speech. Audio is delivered automatically from the tool result — reply with NO_REPLY after a successful call to avoid duplicate messages.'
  },
  modelAliasLines: [],
  userTimezone: 'UTC',
  userTimeFormat: '24h',
  contextFiles,
  skillsPrompt,
  heartbeatPrompt: 'Read HEARTBEAT.md if it exists (workspace context). Follow it strictly. Do not infer or repeat old tasks from prior chats. If nothing needs attention, reply HEARTBEAT_OK.',
  docsPath: '/usr/lib/node_modules/openclaw/docs',
  workspaceNotes: [],

- exec: Run shell commands (pty available for TTY-required CLIs)
- process: Manage background exec sessions
- web_search: Search the web (Brave API)
- web_fetch: Fetch and extract readable content from a URL

- canvas: Present/eval/snapshot the Canvas

- gateway: Restart, apply config, or run updates on the running OpenClaw process
- agents_list: List OpenClaw agent ids allowed for sessions_spawn when runtime="subagent" (not ACP harness ids)

- sessions_send: Send a message to another session/sub-agent
- subagents: List, steer, or kill sub-agent runs for this requester session
